name: Choco ripple cookies
ingredients: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm), Golden Syrup, Cocoa Powder (2%), Milk Solids, Chocolate Chips (0.5%) [Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Dextrose and Emulsifiers (INS 322 from Soy, INS 476)], Leavening Agents (INS 503 ii, INS 500 ii), Emulsifiers (INS 322 from Soy, INS 472e, INS 435 and INS 471), lodised Salt, Artificial Flavouring Substance (Vanillin). Allergen Advice: Contains Wheat, Milk and Soy. May contain traces of Nut.
